weaknesses.title: SYS CHUNK join separator cannot be a variable
weaknesses.detail: SYS CHUNK n bag JSEP parses JSEP as a form name → unknown form 'JSEP' (same for JOIN). Only string literals work for join sep. Agents cannot pass CUBALC_* env join through a LET binding.
weaknesses.repro: LET s=","; SYS CHUNK 2 peers s → unknown form 's'

weaknesses.title: FIRSTMATCH is substring GREP1 — false friends
weaknesses.detail: FIRSTMATCH bag "fail" matches prefail:live before h2:fail. Needle :fail safer but still matches host:failsoft. No whole-field or suffix-anchor match.

weaknesses.title: CHUNK space-joins hosts — irreversible if host contains space
weaknesses.detail: Wave field 'h1 h2' WORDS-split for advance; hostnames with spaces corrupt. No structured batch bag (nested fields).
weaknesses.repro: CHUNK 2 of hosts with spaces flattens

weaknesses.title: BEFOREALL miss keeps whole field; AFTERALL miss empty
weaknesses.detail: Plain orphan rows become fake host ids on peel; AFTERALL injects empty fields needing SQUEEZE. BEFOREALL_HIT not checked by agents by default.

weaknesses.title: No atomic multi-host SETMATCH / advance wave
weaknesses.detail: advance loops EACH host SETMATCH; partial success leaves mixed wave state. No transaction over bag mutations.
weaknesses.repro: advance h1 h2 when only h1 pending → hit=1 miss=1

weaknesses.title: GREP :fail / :live suffix tallies are substring-unsafe
weaknesses.detail: list tallies GREP :live matches :live and :livez. Same class as prior GREP gaps.

weaknesses.title: SYS form trailing args: bare idents are forms not values
weaknesses.detail: General footgun beyond CHUNK: agents expect var expansion for optional host args; parser form-dispatch steals the token. String literals or LAST pipeline only.

workarounds: CHUNK with default space join only; hardcode SYS CHUNK n bag "," if comma needed
FIRSTMATCH with ":fail" not bare fail; still prefer status field EQS walk for safety
